message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime(s) from list.

Facts: Person fabricated a document (a false official document) to hide a prior corruption record, to facilitate winning a bid. This is forging/altering official documents. The list includes:

- 伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章
- 伪造、变造居民身份证
- 伪造公司、企业、事业单位、人民团体印章
- 伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章 (first)
- Also "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" is about forging state documents, seals.

Here they forged a "检察机关行贿犯罪档案查询结果告知函", which is a document from the People's Procuratorate (state organ). They also copied the official seal onto the forged document. So the crime is forging state documents and using forged seal. So label: 伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章

Also possibly "行贿" but they didn't give bribe, they forged to hide prior bribe. The act is forging official documents. So single label.

Thus answer: [罪名]伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章<eoa>
